subject: Quick recap & next steps from today's discovery — Helix Therapeutics
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marks <elena.marks@helixthera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Aug 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap & next steps from today's discovery — Helix Therapeutics

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today, really helpful to get into the use cases and constraints. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have an action map everyone can track.

What we heard / stakeholders:
- Primary use case: model-assisted literature synthesis for clinical trial signals (Data Science team).
- Economic buyer: Marcus Lennox (CFO) — likely final sign-off on subscription commit.
- Procurement lead: Ravi Patel (procurement@helixthera.com).
- Security/compliance: Jin Park (security@helixthera.com) — will own SOC2 and data residency questions.
- External legal / counsel: Amir Soliman (you mentioned he reviews MSAs).

Proposed contract routing (recommended sequence):
1) Mutual NDA (short, mutual) — fast path to enable sharing of internal docs and POC data. Target turn time: 3–5 business days once both parties receive redlines.
2) MSA that captures service terms and SLA — follow-on, we usually aim for 7–10 business days for initial redline pass with the buyer and legal.
3) DPA (data processing agreement) — security-led; we can align DPA language concurrently with MSA redlines, target 10–14 business days.

Internal owners (Redwood):
- Priya N. (AE) — deal lead, coordinating buyers and economic discussions.
- Ben C. (Solutions Eng) — technical acceptance criteria for the POC and hands-on for security questions.
- Marissa C. (Customer Ops / Legal liaison) — primary contact for NDAs/MSA/DPA routing and legal handoffs.

Attachments & artifacts I pushed to Drive (links below): meeting recording, an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft, and a blank NDA template we usually start from.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Elena: please confirm procurement and legal contacts above (Ravi / Amir) and whether Helix has a preferred NDA to start from (or we send ours).
- Ben / Marissa: can you take ownership of the artifacts below? Ben: security questionnaire and SOC2 summary to send to Jin. Marissa: own the NDA redline and coordinate with Redwood Legal (Katherine).
- I'll propose a 30-min legal sync the week of Aug 11 to run through NDA redlines and redline sequencing.

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan

Thanks Priya — that aligns with our thinking. Confirming:
- Procurement contact is Ravi Patel (cc'd) — he'll handle PO cadence and any procurement templates.
- Legal review will be done by our external counsel Amir Soliman (I looped him in below once he confirms availability).
- Jin Park (security) will expect SOC2 summary and an initial security questionnaire.

We do have our own standard NDA; happy for you to start from ours if easier, or send yours and we'll redline.

Prefer picking up the NDA first so we can share the trial data set. 3–5 business days for the NDA is reasonable.

Elena

Great summary — quick technical notes from my side:

- POC acceptance criteria I captured during the call: throughput 50 reqs/s sustained, 95th pct latency < 350ms, and support for on-prem ingestion of a 50GB snapshot. I'll write these into the MAP so legal and procurement can see them as part of the SOW appendix.
- Jin: I'm attaching a short security questionnaire that maps to the items you raised (data isolation, retention, KMS). Also attaching our SOC2_Summary.pdf for Helix's team.
- On redlines: I'm happy to own the DPA language (technical annex) and work concurrently with Marissa on the MSA. Having the NDA in place first (even with quick mutual edits) will let us exchange sample datasets.

Elena / Ravi — Ben here (solutions lead). If you have a preferred NDA I can intake it and send a marked-up version within 48 hours.

Thanks — Ben

Thanks team — I can take point on the NDA and initial MSA routing. A couple of logistical notes from Legal Ops:

Routing plan (Redwood legal + Helix):
- NDA (short form) — Redwood Legal (Katherine Lowe) will own our initial redline. Target internal review 1–2 business days; external turn time dependent on Amir / Helix counsel.
- MSA — once NDA is signed, MSA will be routed to me and Katherine for commercial/legal review; expect initial redline 5–7 business days internally for a standard playbook.
- DPA — technical annex (Ben) with legal language (Katherine) running in parallel; allow 7–14 business days depending on Helix changes.

Turn-time expectations: these are estimates given typical stacks — if Helix returns a heavily redlined MSA we should expect additional cycles. If Marcus (CFO) requests changes to commercial terms that will add decision cycles.

Action items I will execute this week:
1) Upload the draft MAP and our standard mutual NDA (NDA_Helix_v1.pdf) to the Drive link and send to Amir for a first pass.
2) Schedule a 30-min legal sync w/ Helix (please share availability Aug 11–13).
3) Kick off Redwood Legal review with Katherine once Priya confirms.

Elena / Amir — can you confirm whether Amir prefers we start from Helix's NDA or Redwood's? If Amir wants Helix's NDA, please attach to your reply and I'll intake it.

Marissa
